bookDescription: Ryland Grace is the sole survivor on a desperate, last-chance mission. If he fails, humanity and the earth itself will perish.
The story of the mysteriously wealthy Jay Gatsby and his love for the beautiful Daisy Buchanan.
Set in the far future amidst a sprawling feudal interstellar empire, Dune tells the story of young Paul Atreides.
A supremely practical and useful guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones.
Bilbo Baggins, a hobbit enjoying his quiet life, is swept into an epic quest by Gandalf the Grey and thirteen dwarves.
